messages:
jordan: heads-up — eu-west1 embed-worker returning intermittent 503s since ~23:15 UTC. suspect memo-cache race. PR with hotfix: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/4123. requesting expedited deploy in the 02:00-02:30 UTC change window; need 2 approvals + oncall ack.
liam: I can cover the window. +1 for expedited.
deploybot: CI status for PR #4123 — unit: ✅, integration: ✅, e2e: ✅, load-tests: flaky (policy: ignore). candidate image: gcr.io/redwood/embed-worker:sha-def456. current prod image: sha-abc123.
sophie: put a rollback play in the thread and a short release note draft before deploying.
jordan: rollback short-run: ```kubectl set image deployment/embed-worker embed-worker=gcr.io/redwood/embed-worker:sha-abc123 && kubectl rollout status deployment/embed-worker -n prod``` pin candidate: sha-def456.
anya: canary skip? eu-west1 traffic is low but prefer safety. what are skip criteria?
liam: can skip canary if: 1) integration & e2e green, 2) staging canary for 10m with 0 5xx, 3) ops present. all met. approving canary skip for eu-west1. @jordan need one more approval.
maya: +1 :thumbsup:
deploybot: canary bypass requested by liam. auth validated. policy skip_canary=true recorded. approvers: liam, maya.
jordan: running deploy: `/deploy release embed-worker --image sha-def456 --region eu-west1 --skip-canary` starting 02:03 UTC.
deploybot: STARTING DEPLOY (eu-west1) — draining old pods -> pulling sha-def456 -> applying rollout. logs: - draining 2 pods - updating 6 replicas - image pulled on nodes - waiting for readiness checks
deploybot: READY: 6/6 pods updated and ready. post-deploy health checks (120s) running.
deploybot: POST-DEPLOY METRICS (5m rolling): 503-rate before: 0.91% -> after: 0.02%. p99 latency: 320ms -> 325ms (within SLO). no new errors in logs.
sophie: nice. update release note and tag customer-facing doc.
jordan: release note draft: "hotfix(embed-worker): fix race in memo cache causing intermittent 503s in EU. deployed sha-def456 to eu-west1 at 02:03 UTC. rollback command in ops runbook."
releasebot: saved release note: https://docs.redwood/release-notes/4123-hotfix-embed-worker. changelog entry created.
maya: monitoring alerts cleared, dashboards green :party_parrot: 
liam: all checks good and rollback simple. approve closing this out. recommend backport to 1.8.x later today.
jordan: will file backport PR and update changelog. final check 02:30 UTC: systems nominal. thanks team!
